detail.intro: Edit the JSON below. Save validates the payload and replaces this quiz's questions with the questions array in a single transaction; leave the array out to change only the settings. The change is recorded in the audit log.
detail.submissions: {count, plural, one {# submitted attempt} other {# submitted attempts}}. Each result keeps the questions exactly as that learner was asked them, so changes here apply to new attempts only. The questions cannot all be removed; set active to false to take the quiz offline.
detail.schemaReference: Schema reference. The payload accepts title, passThreshold, active, an optional timeLimitSeconds(null = untimed; otherwise an integer between 60 and 7200 = 1 min to 2 h), an optional maxAttempts (null = unlimited; otherwise a whole number from 1 to 20 — attempts each learner may submit), rttSubjectId (the RTT subject the quiz belongs to; it can be changed, not removed; a quiz on a curriculum subject has none, and setting one moves it to that RTT subject), and a questions[] array. Each question must have prompt (string), options (array of ≥ 2 strings), correctIndex (0-based integer into options), and an optional explanation.
